title: The Real Cost of an American Hypercar
description:
What does an American hypercar really cost? The sticker on a Hennessey Venom F5 reached two point one million dollars, and one sold at auction for two million, two hundred five thousand. The SSC Tuatara was reported at one point nine five million. But the sticker is the part we can see. In this video, we count what the sources show, and we tell you plainly what they do not. We use Wikipedia, evo, The Drive, Motor Authority, Motor One, Carscoops, Hennessey's own news page, and the U.S. Census Bureau. Hennessey's own page is a company source, so we label it. Where we do the arithmetic, we say so. And where nobody has published a figure, we will say that too, because on cars like these, the missing numbers are half the story.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:55 The sticker prices
3:24 What the price is measured against
5:19 Price per horsepower
6:53 Buying one
9:19 What the money buys
14:37 What it sells for later
17:04 What running one costs
20:25 The honest total
